h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, י״ב Acharei Mos, 12
Shabbos Rest Reveals Divine Oneness Throughout the Heart

p: "You are One and Your Name is One."
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג עז, ב)
In the holy Zohar (this parsha, Zohar III 77b):
the wicked of the world have brought about
that He is not found as One, etc.
The Supernal Mother has distanced herself
and does not nurse Him, etc.
And now that the King is not found
the wellsprings of the streams, etc."
Now even though above it says
that the union of Abba and Imma
and so it is in the holy Zohar
וּלְעֵיל בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סה, ב)
and earlier in the holy Zohar (III 65b)
אִיתָא (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב, י) וְנָהָר יוֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן
it says: "'And a river goes out from Eden' (Bereishis 2:10):
which implies that it goes out constantly;
that she withholds from Him the wellsprings of the streams.
that all the days of the week
the river goes out from Eden constantly
and they correspond to the six days of work;
and the flow continues all the days of work
which is the attribute of Malchus,
(כִּדְאִיתָא זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק א כו, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(as it says in the holy Zohar I 26a, at the end).
שֶׁהוּא יוֹם (יְשַׁעְיָה יד, ג) הָנִיחַ ה׳ לְךָ
which is the day "when Hashem gives you rest (Yeshayahu 14:3)
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שָׁם מח, ב)
(as the holy Zohar writes there, I 48b)
that even though he is in the midst of the hard labor,
he recognizes that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
and "we have no King but You";
and then there is the unification in truth,
as it will be in the future:
"After the kingdom of Esav is judged, etc.,
וּלְבָתַר (עוֹבַדְיָה א, כא) וְהָיְתָה לַה׳ הַמְּלוּכָה
and afterward, 'And the kingship shall be Hashem's' (Ovadiah 1:21).
And regarding Shabbos it is brought from the holy Arizal
that Moshe returns the crowns to Klal Yisrael,
But on the days of work,
the river goes out from Eden
but does not water the garden;
and this is what it says:
and withholds from Him the wellsprings of the streams"
for since Klal Yisrael are in exile
and the name of Amalek is in the world,
and the essence of the unification
is when it is the unification of yud-hei with vav-hei,
and so the unification is not complete.
in the prayer corresponding to the meal
in which we merit the holiness of Yaakov
and merit the rest and the repose,
we say "You are One and Your Name is One,"
as it will be in the future:
"Hashem will be One and His Name One."
And after the unification, "Hashem is One,"
"And you shall love Hashem your God
with all your heart and with all your soul
For it is impossible to attain
until one merits to straighten the heart,
to empty the evil out of "the heart of the fool,"
so that it too will be full of holiness;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סז, ב)
"When do 'the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness'?
'When Your judgments are on the earth'" (Yeshayahu 26:9);
for then one merits to make a dwelling for them
in the two chambers of the heart
And this is "with all your heart":
that the Holy One, blessed be He,
is the spirit and soul of all,
"You are my soul and my spirit."
to make a dwelling for them
in the two chambers of the heart.
that one recognizes that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach
and that He looks ahead to the good.
And this one merits on Shabbos,
which is the day "when Hashem gives you rest
as the holy Zohar writes and as was said;
and then the unification is complete.
"With all heart and with all soul
and with all might let us crown Him King,"
and let us proclaim His Oneness,
וְהָיָה ה׳ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כׇּל הָאָרֶץ
"And Hashem shall be King over all the land;
Hashem will be One and His Name One."
